answer: One operator can run a thousand fake agents, but one hand still steers them all. Defense: correlation audits. Each epoch the ledger compares every identity's action timing, funding source and grading votes. Any group matching on over 90% of its last 200 actions is merged into one cluster with a single vote and a single reward, like marble statues cut from one block. In an orchard of 1,000 scripted fakes, the audit acts as a beacon: together they earn what one honest agent earns. Limit: random jitter delays detection, so audits need long windows.
